unverified_claims: growth_5y of +127% is an estimate calculated from Cervicorn's CAGR of 17.39% back-calculated to 2021 baseline (~$28.5B) — no direct 2021 AI-in-smart-cities market size found
growth_3m of +6% is a quarterly estimate derived from the annual CAGR; no direct Q2-to-Q3 2026 data available

Siemens 8%, Cisco 5%, Huawei 4%, IBM 3%, Microsoft 2% market share figures are approximate ranges from MarketsandMarkets combined-share data (17-22% for top 5) — individual breakdowns are editorial estimates
Pittsburgh SURTRAC 25% travel time reduction figure is widely cited but original Carnegie Mellon study should be cross-referenced for exact methodology
Hayden AI $48M Series B — sourced from general VC tracking; exact round size should be verified via Crunchbase before publication
notes: All primary market size figures are from paid research reports (Precedence, Cervicorn) summarized in free-access page metadata. Direct numerical claims from McKinsey, Smart Cities Dive, OECD, Capgemini, and Solid Market Research are high-confidence editorial sources. Funding data from Tracxn is aggregated and may lag real-time deal tracking.
